title: Video Detection Result
description: Wire format the video-detection module emits and the fusion engine consumes. Version 1.

schema_version.description: Wire-format version. Bumped only on incompatible changes.

modality.description: Fixed identifier — lets the fusion engine key modules by modality.

video_path.description: Path to the input video the prediction is about.

prediction.description: Discrete decision produced by applying the threshold to prob_synthetic.

prob_synthetic.description: Video-level P(synthetic), mean-pooled from per-frame scores.

confidence.description: Threshold margin, mapped to [0, 1]. 0 = right on the boundary; 1 = maximally confident.

per_frame_scores.description: One P(synthetic) per usable extracted frame.

num_frames_used.description: Number of frames the model actually scored.

explainability_score.description: Peak-inside-central metric averaged over the video's frames. Null when explanation was skipped.

heatmap_dir.description: Directory containing per-frame GradCAM PNGs. Null when explanation was skipped.

timeline_path.description: Path to the per-frame P(synthetic) timeline PNG. Null when explanation was skipped.

meta.description: Freeform provenance — model class, checkpoint path, backbone id, etc.
